source_analysis.skill: Transform a first-order linear ODE into (yI)′ = IQ using an integrating factor.
reasoning_steps: Normalize the derivative coefficient and identify P and Q.
invariants: I is nonzero and satisfies I′ = PI.
Multiply normalized Q by the same I.
Stop before solving for y; retain the radio response.
permitted_variations: Vary eligible coefficients, signs, forcing functions and source-supported normalization.
Vary correct-factor assignments and option positions without revealing the key through bank structure.
